units.kitchen.measures: LADBS building permits, declared job value (apartment kitchen work, per kitchen)
units.kitchen.confidence: LA permit records; declared values tend to run below final cost
units.kitchen.notes: LADBS building permits, declared job value (apartment kitchen work, per kitchen). 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile of 231 LA permits issued 2020-09-02 to 2026-11-04, each value divided by its stated quantity (implausible per-unit values from misread quantities dropped). Permits were read and labelled by a language model; new buildings, revisions and other work were left out.
units.kitchen.excludes: Work on existing apartment kitchens; a new kitchen in former office space also needs supply and drain runs to a riser.

sprinklers.verify_coverage.measures: sprinkler installation per sq ft, applied to the area to be converted as an upper estimate for adapting an existing system
sprinklers.verify_coverage.notes: LADBS building permits, declared job value (sprinkler installation in existing buildings, per sq ft of building). 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile of 142 LA permits issued 2015-04-06 to 2026-11-03, each value divided by its stated quantity (implausible per-unit values from misread quantities dropped). Permits were read and labelled by a language model; new buildings, revisions and other work were left out. Building-wide work: each permit joined by its parcel to the LA County assessor's building area. Used for adapting existing coverage over the converted area: a new system there is the closest priced job, so this reads high. Cross-check: LAFD estimated $6,000 per home to add sprinklers to existing residential high-rises (2017), about $9 per sq ft at 650 gross sq ft per home.
sprinklers.verify_coverage.excludes: Declared job values; design fees, permits and tenant disruption are not included. Rates are per sq ft of the whole building (LA County assessor area). Coverage survey and hydraulic calculation fees are not separated.
